name: Westports Holdings Berhad
summary: Westports Holdings Berhad, an investment holding company, develops and manages ports. The company operates a port under the Westports name in Port Klang, Malaysia. Its port offers container cargo services; conventional services, including dry bulk, break bulk, liquid bulk, cement cargo, and roll-on-roll-off services; and marine services. The company also constructs and operates the terminal facilities; offers container-related terminal handling services to shipping lines and forwarders. Westports Holdings Berhad was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Port Klang, Malaysia.
